property.name: toolNames

property.name: estimatedCost
property.description: Estimated USD cost of the interaction; null when the provider/model has no configured price.

property.name: totalEstimatedCost
property.description: Grand total estimated cost across all priced interactions in the criteria; unpriced interactions are excluded. Only meaningful when all priced interactions share a single currency — see currencyTotals when they differ.

property.name: totalCurrency
property.description: Currency code for the grand total; set only when all priced interactions share a single configured currency, otherwise null.

property.name: currencyTotals
property.description: Estimated cost grand totals grouped by currency; one entry per distinct currency among the priced interactions.

property.name: hasUnpricedInteractions
property.description: True when at least one interaction in the criteria has no configured price.

property.name: inputPricePerMillion
property.description: Configured price per 1,000,000 input tokens; null when unpriced.

property.name: outputPricePerMillion
property.description: Configured price per 1,000,000 output tokens; null when unpriced.

property.name: currency
property.description: Optional currency code configured alongside the model prices (e.g. USD); null when not configured.

property.name: isPriced
property.description: True only when both input and output prices are valid non-negative decimals.

property.name: estimatedCost
property.description: Estimated cost for this provider/model group; null when unpriced.

property.description: Optional currency code configured for this provider/model's prices; null when not configured.

property.name: totalEstimatedCost
